intent: Reduce repeated coordination commands and make project startup/install results easier to inspect.
core_changes: Explicit start --apply-setup over managed setup receipts
Bounded foreground worker watch with optional waiting, progress and explicit inbox receipts
Independent watcher and runner locks over shared Manager communication
Explicit native CLI selection and isolated profile binding
Bundled Skill and bilingual first-use guidance
contracts: No implicit daemon, provider selection, retries, takeover, approval or Git checkpoint
No managed-service or global client configuration changes
tests: Real worktree dependency/handoff/receipt and foreground process checks
Failure, timeout, scope, interruption and watcher exclusion
Native proxy/profile mismatch and explicit local CLI verification
Source, reused isolated wheel environment, platform CI and published readback
risks: Trusted harness still required; deterministic fixtures are not AI models
Prior dirty changes can block a different task scope
Foreground waits are bounded and do not wake client GUIs
Local native OpenClaw and managed-service proxy are separate verification scopes
WorkBuddy UI and autonomous model collaboration remain unverified
